description: This is a Java test class named `LoanOriginationValidationTest` that contains multiple JUnit test cases to validate mandatory parameters and error handling during loan origination processes in an Apache Fineract-based financial application. It tests scenarios such as missing dates during approval and disbursement, and missing required parameters during loan application, ensuring proper validation and error responses.

classes.name: LoanOriginationValidationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that performs validation tests for loan origination processes within the Apache Fineract framework, focusing on mandatory parameters and error handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes configurations, creates necessary accounts, and sets up test data before all tests run.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: uc1
methods.description: Test case to verify approval process fails when 'approvedOnDate' parameter is missing.

methods.name: uc2
methods.description: Test case to verify disbursement process fails when 'actualDisbursementDate' parameter is missing.

methods.name: uc3
methods.description: Test case to verify that applying for a loan without required parameters results in validation errors.
